description: Authority chains that fail (spec/SPEC.md §6): each case names the rule it breaks and the result. The rules run in order, each over every hop before the next, so a chain that breaks several rules fails with the first; the cases named "order" pin that.
suite_parameters: Ed25519 signatures; sealing with RFC 9180 base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) (kem 0x0020), HKDF-SHA256 (kdf 0x0001), AES-256-GCM (aead 0x0002)
test_data: Every seed, private key, content key and nonce in this file is test data, fixed by construction: seeds are one byte repeated 32 times, and the rest comes from a seeded xorshift128+. They are public; never let them protect anything real.
notes: rule: 1 hops <= 8; 2 each hop well-formed; 3 caveats <= 32 per hop; 4 each caveat <= 256 UTF-8 bytes; 5 hop[i].sub == hop[i+1].iss; 6 the last sub is from; 7 hop[i+1].exp <= hop[i].exp; 8 ts <= exp for every hop; 9 every hop sig verifies under its iss.
